aiVerification.summary: Draft cites usable rows but misidentifies the primary changed factor as machine instead of dry temperature/time conditions.
issues: Primary changed factor is dry temperature and dry time, not Machine 1 vs Machine 2.
Baseline or normal condition is not explicit and should not be invented.
Machine should be a subgroup key, not the changed condition.
Change domain should be process condition only, not material.
Outcome metric should be NG separate SMG or NG rate, not generic result checking.
correctionPlan: Regroup changed factor as dry condition parameters: temperature and dry time.
Set baselineCondition to not explicit or parameter trial without baseline.
Use heating press machine as subgroup context with date.
Preserve each temp/time/machine row as a subresult.
Rename outcome to NG separate SMG count and NG rate.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are row-existing but not sufficient until aligned to dry temp/time grouping.
